newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil stable.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was stable on Thursday as crude oil futures drifted back to Wednesday's levels, traders said.
An NWE refiner bought a Russian 1.2 percent sulphur cargo from a trader at a p+c price a few dollars under E-4 talk.
Another trader was heard offering a very prompt M-100 at between $112 and $114 cif NWE.
In the Med, a couple of M-40 cargoes were heard available at around $5 over the m/m/m of published quotes. Low sulphur markets were very thin, with traders at a wide stand off.
